title: Unbounded Buffer Read in DnsPacketParser
notes: Low risk as the exception would merely drop the packet and be caught by the general Exception handler in the packet loop, but should be fixed for stability.
remediation: Add buffer size checks before extracting UDP payload and DNS domains.

title: Missing Intent Action Validation
notes: FocusDeviceAdminReceiver inherits from DeviceAdminReceiver which inherently validates system actions (like ACTION_DEVICE_ADMIN_DISABLE_REQUESTED). Intents must come from the system.
